tasks.script:
-- Part "Answer" of card "Cafe"
-- Answers a guest about today's menu, using the card's agent,
-- and falls back to the raw menu when the agent stays silent.
on openCard
  consult agent with "A guest asks: what is served today at the cafe? The menu of the day is:" & return & field "Menu" & return & "Reply in one short sentence."
  put it into reply
  if reply is empty then
    put "Today at the cafe:" && field "Menu" into field "Answer"
  else
    put reply into field "Answer"
  end if
end openCard
paraphrase: Ask this card's agent: "A guest asks: what is served today at the cafe? The menu of the day is:" followed by a line break followed by field Menu followed by a line break followed by "Reply in one short sentence.", and wait for its answer.
Write the last result in reply.
Write "Today at the cafe:" followed by a space and field Menu in field Answer.

  put 0 into total
  put 0 into count
  repeat for each line row in field "Scores"
    if row is not empty then
      add row to total
      add 1 to count
    end if
  end repeat
  if count > 0 then

  else
    put empty into field "Average"
  end if
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat for each line of field Scores, calling it row:
Write total divided by count rounded to 1 decimals in field Average.
